svg.title: Link reliability: a blocked beam delays, not loses
svg.desc: Sequence diagram with a Doctor Station lane and a Bed Unit lane. Acknowledge: a frame is sent, the Bed Unit acknowledges, the sender shows Delivered. Retry: a lost frame gets no acknowledgement, so after a random back-off the frame is sent again, up to 3 retries. Ignore repeats: a copy received within 8 s of the previous one is ignored. Listen first: Bed Units listen before talking and resend an unconfirmed request or answer every 3 s. Can't breathe, in red: the Bed Unit resends every 1.5 s and the Doctor Station alarm repeats until acknowledged. Beacon: every 15 s the Doctor Station checks the selected bed; Link *** shows on the doctor and Link OK on the bed. Infrared needs line of sight, so the protocol makes every failure visible and recoverable.
